text_block_list.text:
I knew it, it's from Mom! Whoa~! She's 
entering a nationwide dance competition?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
She's chasing her own dream too. In that 
case, I can't afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch, Mama! I'm gonna build a 
castle so big your jaw will drop to the 
floor!
